profile.reading:
DataBank was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Dallas, Texas. Digital Bridge, now DigitalBridge Group, acquired the company in July 2016 and used it to launch a broader data center investment platform. Trade press reports DigitalBridge later sold a stake in DataBank to Swiss Life Asset Management for approximately $1.2 billion, a transaction this entry records from secondary reporting rather than a confirmed primary source.

DataBanks own company-history page describes growth to more than 65 data centers across more than 27 markets following a series of acquisitions, without stating a precise current total. Among those acquisitions, a January 2022 press release describes DataBank buying Houston-area data centers from CyrusOne, another operator separately tracked in this registry, an example of consolidation moving facilities directly between two operators already profiled here.

The registry here tracks 14 DataBank facilities across six states, California, Nevada, New York, Texas, Utah, and Virginia. As a DigitalBridge-sponsored colocation platform built substantially through acquisition, including at least one purchase directly from CyrusOne, DataBanks history is a useful cross-check for this registrys later facility-level work: any DataBank facility in the Houston, Texas area should be checked against former CyrusOne records for a possible former_operator relationship rather than treated as an independent new build. This specific facility, recorded in this registry as DataBank Pittsburgh PIT2 in Pittsburgh, PA, was not individually named in the operator-level research above; its operator field was blank in the source data and is corrected here to DataBank based on the facility own name, which unambiguously identifies its operator brand. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.
profile.research_note: Operator field corrected from blank to DataBank based on the facility own name (source data left operator blank). Reused operator-level research from twoai_dc_operators row: DataBank.
